tell: A JAK inhibitor excreted mostly unchanged, 69% in urine, and a substrate of the OAT3 transporter.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is approximately 80%, and about 50% is bound to plasma proteins. Renal elimination is the principal clearance route, and meals have no clinically relevant effect on exposure.
The active moiety has a molecular weight of 371.42, and the description names no salt form.
Approved under an NDA as 1, 2 and 4 mg tablets, dosed once daily with minimal accumulation.

Boxed warning for serious infections, mortality, malignancy, major adverse cardiovascular events and thrombosis; no contraindications. Upper respiratory and urinary tract infections are the most common.
Moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis in adults with an inadequate response to one or more TNF blockers. Also COVID-19 in hospitalized adults, and severe alopecia areata.
It inhibits Janus kinase enzymes, blocking the phosphorylation and activation of STATs that transmit cytokine signals. Which JAK enzymes matter therapeutically is not known.
The generic name begins with B and has eleven letters.
